RYA-794 derived science-ready product from the RYA-789 holding: CRIRES+ Vesta solar Y band, 10280-10680 A, 13707 rows. Source A (sp/Sun_Y_rv.dat, md5 8428f7009e59c6073ba11242b83d48ff); source B (our own Vesta IDPs) DOES NOT EXIST on Sirius - zero Vesta FITS - so molecfit had nothing to run on and Step 1 is blocked, not skipped. Telluric state MEASURED not assumed: 0.10% of window points below 0.5 vs 51.3% for Kitt Peak in the O2 A-band. 18 CRIRES+ Vesta solar IDPs, re-pulled from the ESO archive to /mnt/codex-data/spectra/vesta/CRIRESPlus (37 MB, anonymous, public). RYA-794 recorded these as absent from Sirius and that was correct - they were lost from US, never from ESO. VINTAGE CONFIRMED FROM HEADERS, which RYA-794 could not do: INSTRUME=CRIRES with PRO REC1 PIPE ID=1.6.9 (cr2res is the CRIRES+ pipeline, so this is CRIRES+, not the 2012-13 CRIRES), OBJECT=Vesta, DATE-OBS 2022-11-21..25, 13 settings Y1028/Y1029 J1226/1228/1232 H1559/1567/1575/1582 K2148/2166/2192/2217, R~86000. NOTE: PROG ID is 60.A-9051(A), NOT the 1102.22KH/109.234G that RYA-377 states. SPECSYS=TOPOCENT so a barycentric correction is OWED. Coverage tested against real pixels (QUAL==0, finite non-zero flux), not WAVELMIN/MAX, per RYA-377 detector-gap warning: 807488 valid pixels over 9479-24855 A, and ALL 189 Elgueta-certified G-dwarf lines are reached with ZERO gaps - Fe I 74, Si I 42, C I 22, Mg I 12, Ni I 10, Ca I 8, Cr I 7, S I 5, Ti I 4, P I 2, Sr II/Zn I/K I 1 each.
